layer.name: news-trending-deps

layer.name: openpyxl-layer
layer.note: IMPORTANT: The aws_lambda_layer_version resource lives in bd-pipeline Terraform module, not shared-infra. Yang-pipeline references a hardcoded version :1 ARN in main.tf rather than reading from bd-pipeline state. This is a cross-pipeline dependency gap — if a new layer version is published from bd-pipeline, yang-pipeline will not automatically pick it up.

portal_notifications.adding_a_new_trigger: Add a lambda_function block to aws_s3_bucket_notification.portal_triggers in portal-notifications/main.tf. Add a corresponding aws_lambda_permission resource in the same file. Give the pipeline Lambda an aws_lambda_permission allowing s3.amazonaws.com. Apply portal-notifications Terraform. Do NOT add S3 notification config in individual pipeline modules — that would conflict with the singleton resource here.

auth_infrastructure.jwt_flow_summary: Portal frontend stores Cognito access token in localStorage (key: accessToken). All API calls include Authorization: Bearer {accessToken} header. Optional API key sent as X-Api-Key header (from VITE_PORTAL_API_KEY env var). CloudFront viewer-request Lambda (opal-portal-authorizer) validates the token before forwarding to API Gateway origin. Token refresh logic is handled by AuthContext in the portal.

issue.title: openpyxl-layer owned by bd-pipeline module, not shared-infra
issue.detail: aws_lambda_layer_version.openpyxl_layer is defined in bd-pipeline/layers.tf. Yang-pipeline references it via hardcoded ARN ":1" rather than reading from bd-pipeline TF state. If bd-pipeline publishes a new layer version, yang-pipeline will continue to use version :1 until manually updated.
issue.action: Move openpyxl-layer aws_lambda_layer_version to shared-infra or create an output from bd-pipeline. Update yang-pipeline to use a data source reference instead of hardcoded ARN.
